market_outlook.short_term: Elevated volatility expected. Bond selloff likely to continue (Dunn: room to go further), pressuring equities. Oil above $103 and diesel ban risk keep inflation elevated. Fed October hike now priced. Nasdaq vulnerable from record. US-China truce provides floor but Trump-Xi summit caution limits upside. Hormuz talks could provide relief if successful.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex cycle remains structural tailwind for tech infrastructure. Rising rates create headwinds for housing and consumer credit through 2027. US-China relationship 'too big to fail' but structural tech decoupling persists. Fed stablecoin framework and crypto maturation reshape monetary landscape. Defense spending structural. Housing correction likely if rates stay elevated. EM recovery delayed by carry unwind.
